## Who shares our characteristics
STXBP1-related disease sits in the Neurotransmitter release cycle research cluster. [8b8a74101835d1d2]

SNAP25-related disease shares neurotransmitter release cycle processes with STXBP1. [fcb938d1b0386f7c]

## What already exists
The Natural History Study in Pediatric Patients with STXBP1 Encephalopathy with Epilepsy (NCT05462054) exists for STXBP1-related disease. [bc71e274e1c691ec]
The STXBP1 and SYNGAP1 Related Disorders Natural History Study (NCT06555965) already enrolls individuals with STXBP1-related disease. [dcec503694916ae3]

## What differs and must be verified
DNM1-related disease overlaps only weakly with STXBP1 at the process level: both are annotated to vesicle organization, and overall similarity between the diseases is limited. [6df8a36e97901f12, f1a54e7fce5ac22f, 34c673fba26b1793]

GRIN1-related disease shares only one process with STXBP1 (Neurexins and neuroligins). [9b5a310872598764, 072a91fd2fdb335f, ce6dd3aad07a277e]
Variant patterns differ: STXBP1 shows loss-of-function reports, while CACNA1A shows gain-of-function reports. [87257c69fcfbcdad, df57b34e24ef5206, 4e69b8ecbf6740e9, c3ec464ea6412040]

Genotype–phenotype consistency in STXBP1 remains uncertain, with no clear correlations reported. [b1f9e5eeafbc81d2, e362983ef11a54b1, ddc8cd6784a496fb]

## Who to contact
Ingo Helbig (Children's Hospital of Philadelphia) links both STXBP1- and DNM1-related work and is listed on the STXBP1/SYNGAP1 natural history study. [0bead7fade435d02, 1787b8db0c61e674, 18e9e45f700b90dd, 748b09f0bdfbb400]

## Proposed first joint step
Review the STXBP1 and SYNGAP1 Related Disorders Natural History Study (NCT06555965) to see if it can include DNM1-related disease and confirm Ingo Helbig as the contact for this study.
